description: Delete finished predictions from this account's run history, up to 100 at a time. They stop appearing in list_predictions and get_prediction, and this tool cannot bring them back. Runs that are still going are left alone, and only the key's own organization's records are deleted. Ask the user first, and pass confirm: true only after they agreed to delete these ids.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user has agreed to delete these predictions

name: delete_predictions
